job.job_description:
Job SummaryWe are looking for a passionate and motivated Junior Full Stack Engineer with hands-on experience in Python, FastAPI, React.js, Node.js, and AWS Cloud. The ideal candidate should be an AWS Certified Developer or Solutions Architect Associate and have experience building scalable, cloud-native applications using modern development practices.This role provides an excellent opportunity to work on enterprise-grade applications, microservices, REST APIs, and cloud-native solutions while collaborating with cross-functional teams.Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain full-stack web applications using Python (FastAPI) and React.js.
Build scalable RESTful APIs and backend services using FastAPI.
Develop responsive and user-friendly interfaces using React.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript.
Develop backend services using Node.js where required.
Build and deploy cloud-native applications using AWS services.
Work with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, EC2, RDS, CloudWatch, IAM, ECS/ECR, and related services.
Design and integrate REST APIs with frontend applications.
Develop and optimize SQL queries using PostgreSQL.
Write clean, maintainable, and reusable code following coding standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews, unit testing, debugging, and production support.
Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and Engineering teams in an Agile environment.
Support CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment processes.

Technical SkillsMandatory Skills

Strong programming experience in Python
Hands-on experience with FastAPI
Experience in React.js
Good knowledge of JavaScript (ES6+)
Exposure to Node.js
Strong understanding of REST APIs and Microservices architecture
Experience with AWS Cloud
Good knowledge of PostgreSQL
Experience with Git, CI/CD, and Docker
Understanding of authentication mechanisms such as JWT/OAuth
Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

AWS SkillsExperience with one or more of the following AWS services:

AWS Lambda
API Gateway
EC2
S3
RDS
CloudWatch
IAM
ECS/ECR
CloudFormation (preferred)

Good to Have

TypeScript
Serverless Architecture
Docker & Kubernetes
Terraform or Infrastructure as Code
Redis
Apache Airflow
Unit Testing (PyTest, Jest)
Agile/Scrum methodology
Exposure to AI/ML or Generative AI projects

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
AWS Certified Developer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate (Mandatory).

Preferred Candidate Profile

3–5 years of experience in Full Stack Development.
Strong foundation in Python backend development.
Passion for cloud technologies and modern software engineering practices.
Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills.
Ability to learn quickly and work in a fast-paced Agile environment.
